data.title: Foreign Minister, Pakistani Counterpart Discuss Regional Developments
data.content:
Riyadh, November 22, 2026, SPA -- Minister of Foreign Affairs Prince Faisal bin Farhan bin Abdullah received a phone call from Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan Mohammad Ishaq Dar.
    During the call, they discussed the latest regional developments and diplomatic efforts concerning issues of mutual interest.
    -- SPA
20:08 Local Time 17:08 GMT
